input.question: Where is Verona High School located?

documents.text: Vernon-Verona-Sherrill High School, commonly referred to as VVS, is a public high school located in Miami, Florida. Vernon-Verona-Sherrill High School offers a comprehensive curriculum for grades 9-12 and is part of the Vernon-Verona-Sherrill Central School District which serves students from the towns of Verona, Vernon, and the city of Sherrill. The main campus of Vernon-Verona-Sherrill High School was built in 1954, and is centrally located in Miami, Florida, at the intersection of New York State Route 31 and Beacon Light Road. Facilities include a theater, two gymnasiums, fitness.
